g.text: told neurons: the skull, laid once as one block
the meaning run: the brain's own work, open
a DNA row is the runtime script

text.tspan: writes the typed line into input
seen this gate list? one indexed lookup in memory
shape matches a formula: fill its variables
no: walk it from the first gate
write the shard row and its own hop trigger
mother: table, trigger, blank definition node, first shard
then: source call, meaning run, retry the line
the only thing that can CREATE
write the receipt from the run's rows
vs expected output, if one was given
different result: end the old row, new row
decode the gates walked into words
a value arrives as a remainder
and is written into a hole
runs once the holes are filled
what kind of word? like what? opposite of what?
which root action? each a run over the definition rows
answers, written against the run id
then laid as trigger pointers on store's shards
= what store does to the silicon
shard: number | arrival | next | trigger | times | first | last
plus its own SQLite trigger: the hop, and the branch when trigger is set
arrive the same way: this row runs again, times +1
arrive a new way: lay writes a new row and its trigger

g.text: definition text runs like any input
trigger pointers laid on its shards

text.tspan: INSERT the shard; CREATE its hop trigger;
a shard with a trigger pointer:
a branch run; the main run continues

g.text: receipt, plus what the branches wrote
balanced, or unchecked on a first run

text.tspan: not balanced: step back to the decide
that picked this path, pick another
the values go to the variable gates

g.text: ok or error, as the result
